let profile = model_entry
            .import_settings
            .humanoid_profiles
            .iter()
            .find(|profile| {
                engine::asset::HumanoidBone::REQUIRED
                    .iter()
                    .all(|bone| profile.bones.contains_key(bone))
                    && model_entry
                        .import_settings
                        .skeleton_records
                        .iter()
                        .any(|record| {
                            record.id == profile.skeleton
                                && record.identity == profile.skeleton_identity
                        })
            })
            .cloned()?;
